tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
tasks.description:
创建 Note 模型用于存储笔记。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 note.py 文件，定义 Note 类，包含字段: id (int, 主键), content (str, 笔记内容), created_at (datetime, 创建时间)。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 设置数据库迁移
tasks.description:
配置数据库迁移以支持 Note 模型。在 app/migrations/ 目录下创建迁移文件，生成 notes 表，包含 id, content, created_at 字段。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记API
tasks.description:
创建笔记的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 目录下创建 notes.py 文件，定义 POST 和 GET 路由，分别用于创建和获取笔记。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记前端页面
tasks.description:
创建笔记管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 目录下创建 notes.html 文件，包含一个表单用于输入笔记内容，以及一个列表用于显示已保存的笔记。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 实现前后端集成
tasks.description:
将前端页面与后端 API 集成。在 notes.html 中通过 JavaScript 实现表单提交到 /notes POST 接口，并通过 /notes GET 接口加载笔记列表。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Note model with fields like title, content, timestamp, and user association in the backend framework.
T1.notes: Ensure proper validation and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Use a migration tool to generate and apply database migrations for the Note model.
T2.notes: Test migrations in a development environment before applying to production.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes using the backend framework.
T3.notes: Secure endpoints with authentication and authorization mechanisms.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a frontend page with forms for creating, editing, and viewing notes using a modern UI framework.
T4.notes: Ensure the UI is responsive and user-friendly.

T5.implementation_approach: Integrate the frontend with the backend API using AJAX or a library like Axios for API calls.
T5.notes: Handle errors gracefully and ensure proper synchronization between frontend and backend.

## 关键接口规范

### 1. 模型规范 (app/models/__init__.py)
```python
from app import db

class ModelName(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'table_name'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    # 其他字段...

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            # 其他字段...
        }
```

### 2. 路由规范 (app/routes/xxx.py)
```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from app import db
from app.models.xxx import ModelName

xxx_bp = Blueprint('xxx', __name__)

@xxx_bp.route('/xxx', methods=['GET'])
def get_xxx():
    items = ModelName.query.all()
    return jsonify([item.to_dict() for item in items])

@xxx_bp.route('/xxx', methods=['POST'])
def create_xxx():
    data = request.get_json()
    item = ModelName(字段=data['字段'])
    db.session.add(item)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify(item.to_dict()), 201
```

### 3. 注册蓝图规范 (app/__init__.py)
```python
# 导入蓝图
from app.routes.xxx import xxx_bp

# 注册蓝图
app.register_blueprint(xxx_bp, url_prefix='/api')
```

### 4. 前端模板规范 (templates/xxx.html)
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Title</title>
    <script>
        const API_BASE = '/api';
        // 使用 fetch 调用 API
    </script>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- 页面内容 -->
</body>
</html>
```

from flask import Flask
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_cors import CORS
from config import get_config

# Initialize extensions
db = SQLAlchemy()


def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__, template_folder='../templates')

    # Load configuration
    config_class = get_config()
    app.config.from_object(config_class)

    # Initialize extensions
    db.init_app(app)
    CORS(app)

    # Import and register blueprints
    from app.routes.notes import notes_bp
    app.register_blueprint(notes_bp, url_prefix='/api')

    return app

from __future__ import with_statement
import logging
from flask import current_app
from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool
from sqlalchemy import MetaData
USE_TWOPHASE = False
config = context.config
metadata = MetaData()
def run_migrations():
    connectable = current_app.extensions['migrate'].db.engine
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=metadata)
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()
if context.is_offline_mode():
    context.configure(url=config.get_main_option('sqlalchemy.url'))
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()
else:
    run_migrations()
